instruction: Drop 6-8 through-hole stitching vias on a roughly uniform grid inside the pre-existing GND polygon on `/home/user/Desktop/poured.brd`, and save the board as `/home/user/Desktop/stitched.brd`. Requirements: 1. It parses as well-formed XML. 2. >= 6 new `<via>` elements appear as children of `<signal name='GND'>`. 3. Every new via sits inside the GND polygon's bounding box. 4. The new vias span at least 10 mm in x and 5 mm in y (evidence of a real grid rather than clustered in one spot). 5. The GND `<polygon layer='1'>` is still present. 6. The `<element>` count is unchanged vs. The starter.
